report.summary: All four UI failures come from one cause: the app's list_books() path sleeps a random 0-8 s when the slow_list bug is enabled, and the UI tests give page loads and clicks only 5 s. Every failing step (goto /books, register submit, add-book submit) renders the book list, so the timeouts are timing failures, not wrong behavior. First step: confirm whether BUGS=slow_list is set in the CI environment, then either turn it off for the UI suite or stop the app from sleeping on the request path.

causes.title: Random 0-8 s delay in list_books exceeds the 5 s UI timeout
causes.explanation: With the slow_list seeded bug on, list_books() sleeps random.uniform(0, 8) seconds before querying. Every UI page that renders the book list (GET /books, POST /books, and the POST /register redirect target) calls list_books(), so the response can take longer than the 5 s limit. tests/ui/conftest.py sets page.set_default_timeout(5000), so page.goto('/books') and the submit clicks time out whenever the draw is above about 5 s (roughly 3/8 of calls). That is why the same code can pass on a rerun. The four failing tests all hit this path; the passing UI tests that also load /books just drew a shorter delay. The fourth test never got to its assertions: the 422 year-validation response also goes through render_books()/list_books(), so the click timed out before the error text could be checked. The workflow file does not set BUGS, so the env used for this run must have had slow_list enabled. I could not confirm that from the CI config or timing logs, so confidence is medium. Fix: run the UI suite without slow_list, or make the delay deterministic and short in tests. Also consider removing the sleep from the request path, or giving slow-by-design flows a larger timeout instead of the global 5 s default.
evidence: app/main.py:12: slow_list        random 0-8 s delay when listing books (flaky timing)
app/main.py:159-161: def list_books(user_id): if "slow_list" in BUGS: time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8))
app/main.py:264-275: render_books() calls list_books(user["id"]) for every books page render
app/main.py:328 and 350: GET /books and the POST /books redirect path both render or redirect into the book list
app/main.py:311: POST /register redirects to /books, which triggers list_books on the next load
tests/ui/conftest.py:6-7: "Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s" / page.set_default_timeout(5000)
tests/support/pages.py:22: self.page.get_by_test_id("submit").click() -> waiting for scheduled navigations to finish (test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf)
tests/support/pages.py:44: self.page.get_by_test_id("add-book").click() -> waiting for scheduled navigations to finish (test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input)
.github/workflows/tests.yml:35-38: pytest run sets no BUGS env var, so slow_list must come from the run environment (unverified)
causes.suggested_fix: Run the UI suite with BUGS unset (or without slow_list), and confirm the environment that produced this run. If slow_list must stay on for other purposes, move the delay out of the request path, or give UI navigations a longer timeout than 5 s. Then rerun the four tests several times to confirm they are stable.
